name: open-scientist
description: ResearchStudio idea_spark as the backbone (retrieval, bottleneck diagnosis, generation, gauntlet, idea card), with a mainline-first formulation after Phase 0 (blind first pass + crux validation: one mainline, at most two causally linked branches) and an independent soundness gate (verifier agent: KILL / CHECK / PASS against the project's code and measured facts) after Phase 1 for gaps and after Phase 3 for cards, so ideas die before training. Problem-selection (from Anthropic's scientific-problem-selection) only ranks what passed.
